# viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud Load Balancer by ID or combined filters. Specify at least one criterion. All configured criteria must match exactly one Load Balancer. Deleted Load Balancers are excluded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup Load Balancer by ID
data "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup Load Balancer by name
data "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "by_name" {
  name = "primary"
}

# Lookup Load Balancer by name within a region
data "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "by_name_and_region" {
  name   = "primary"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}

# Lookup by ID with an address filter
data "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "by_address" {
  id          = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  vip_address = "10.0.0.10"
}

# Lookup with several filters
data "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "by_filters" {
  name               = "primary"
  region             = "vn-central-1"
  package            = "SMALL"
  topology           = "SINGLE"
  type               = "native"
  access_log_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_log_enabled` (Boolean) Filter by access log status. The value false selects Load Balancers with access logs disabled.
- `id` (String) Load Balancer ID (UUID). Exactly one Load Balancer must match.
- `name` (String) Name of the Load Balancer to filter by.
- `package` (String) Load Balancer package to filter by: SMALL, MEDIUM, or LARGE.
- `public_address` (String) Public IPv4 address to filter by, when present.
- `region` (String) Project region name to filter by. Combine it with a name or ID when the region contains multiple Load Balancers.
- `topology` (String) Load Balancer topology to filter by: SINGLE or ACTIVE_STANDBY.
- `type` (String) Load Balancer type to filter by: native or appliance.
- `v6_public_address` (String) Public IPv6 address to filter by, when present.
- `vip_address` (String) Private VIP address to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `access_log_store_id` (String) Access log store ID (UUID), when present.
- `access_log_store_name` (String) Name of the access log store, when present.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Load Balancer was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description of the Load Balancer.
- `private_ip_id` (String) Private IP ID (UUID) used as the VIP, when present.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status.
- `qos_policy_id` (String) QoS policy ID (UUID) assigned to the Load Balancer, when present.
- `qos_policy_name` (String) Name of the assigned QoS policy, when present.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `status` (String) Current operating status.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Load Balancer was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) containing the Load Balancer.
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC containing the Load Balancer.
